Task: Add independently-discoverable unittest test methods to Lib/test/test_configparser.py verifying copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, and pickle round-trips of a real parser-raised MultilineContinuationError. Two inputs: offending continuation line WITH final newline and WITHOUT. For each, check restored: exact class, constructor args, source, one-based lineno, raw offending line, errors list, diagnostic message. Follow existing conventions. Only this test file may change.

Key facts:
- MultilineContinuationError(source,lineno,line) -> ParsingError(source) sets source,errors=[],args=(source,); append(lineno,line) appends errors and message; sets self.lineno,self.line,args=(source,lineno,line). Error.__init__ sets self.message=msg; __str__/__repr__=message.
- Raise site (configparser.py ~1061): in _parse, indented continuation line when cursect[optname] is None -> raise MultilineContinuationError(fpname,lineno,line). fpname is source name; line is raw line incl. indent and trailing \n if present.
- Test helper: CfgParserTestCaseClass.fromstring(string)->newconfig().read_string(string). BasicTestCase class. Existing test test_multilinecontinuationerror at line 1852.
- Next: find pickle/copy conventions in this test file, then exact trigger input.
